about: Tasks for the agent on the same made-up files (D-170), written to need more than one step: facts from two files, or a sum on what was found. gold holds what a right answer says, in any of the forms given. Too few to measure quality: they show whether the agent works and how the Guardian behaves beside it.

tasks.task: How many years passed between the building of the harbour of Port Alder and the opening of the Riverside Museum?
How much do two adult ferry tickets and one child ferry ticket cost together?
How many books and paintings does the Riverside Museum hold in total?
What is the population of Port Alder, and how many docks does its harbour have?
On which day is the Riverside Library closed, and how many people does its reading room seat?
Who is the mayor of Port Alder, and in what year was the mayor elected?
How many hours a day is the Riverside Library open?
Which documents are in the library?
